name: Band Pull-Apart
summary: A simple band exercise that trains the rear shoulders and upper back. It is useful as a warm-up or posture-friendly accessory at home.
setup: Hold a light resistance band in front of you at chest height with arms straight.
Use an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart, with enough tension to keep the band taut.
Stand tall with ribs down, glutes tight and shoulders relaxed.
execution: Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides, keeping your arms straight.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together as the band reaches your chest.
Pause for a moment, then return slowly to the start.
Keep your neck relaxed and wrists neutral.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders: keep them down and away from your ears.
Arching the lower back: tighten the abs and glutes.
Using a band that is too strong: choose one that lets you move smoothly through the full range.
Letting the band snap back: control the return with your back muscles.

references.title: The Band Pull-Apart for a Stronger Back
